recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. No further core source change is needed for FHIR-40448 beyond normal regeneration of built artifacts; Jira keys that only shared the historical implementation commit should be handled as separate reconciliation work if selected.
issue_request: FHIR-40448 was Published/Persuasive for R5 by FM and requested three PaymentNotice corrections: fix the identifier short description typo from 'noctice' to 'notice', change PaymentNotice.payment from 1..1 to 0..1, and rename PaymentNotice.provider to PaymentNotice.reporter with the description 'Entity reporting payment'.
initial_application: Commit 2be1440043170cc0df19d0f270235e5d232d262d applied the identifier typo fix, changed PaymentNotice.payment min cardinality to 0, renamed the StructureDefinition element and example XML from provider to reporter, and recorded the provider-to-reporter rename in fhir.ini. It left PaymentNotice.reporter.short as the old 'Responsible practitioner' wording, so the generated element summary remained stale.
additional_context: PaymentNotice is active in source/fhir.ini and the R4-to-current rename map already captures PaymentNotice.provider to PaymentNotice.reporter. Current source and R5/build profile checks showed the identifier and payment cardinality were correct, while PaymentNotice.reporter.short still exposed the stale old text. The PaymentNotice Event mapping exception source mirrored that stale short label. Later PaymentNotice commits changed other elements and did not reverse the reporter decision. Quoted Zulip and Confluence searches found no relevant contrary community record.
reconciliation: Updated source/paymentnotice/structuredefinition-PaymentNotice.xml so PaymentNotice.reporter.short is 'Entity reporting payment' and updated source/paymentnotice/paymentnotice-event-mapping-exceptions.xml to keep the Event mapping exception source in sync. The reporter definition sentence was left unchanged because it already expresses the reporting role in complete definition form.
source_changes: source/paymentnotice/structuredefinition-PaymentNotice.xml: changed PaymentNotice.reporter.short from 'Responsible practitioner' to 'Entity reporting payment'.
source/paymentnotice/paymentnotice-event-mapping-exceptions.xml: changed the mirrored PaymentNotice.reporter resource short value to 'Entity reporting payment'.
